topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture scope, learning objectives, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and oncogenic pathway activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how mutations in cell surface receptors and downstream intracellular cascades drive independent proliferative signaling in cancer.

topics.label: Block to terminal cell differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how cancers arrest cellular maturation across hematopoietic lineages and intestinal crypt epithelium while sustaining proliferation.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis through p53 and Bcl-2 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 signaling and the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins.

topics.label: Telomere maintenance, replicative immortality, and p53 stress surveillance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells bypass finite replicative lifespans and cellular senescence through telomerase activation while overriding p53-dependent stress checkpoints.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire metabolic pathways toward aerobic glycolysis and how Krebs cycle mutations generate oncogenic metabolites.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how tumors overcome diffusion limits and sustain growth by switching on new blood vessel formation.

topics.label: Mechanisms, clinical monitoring, and genomics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the biological steps of the metastatic cascade, its clinical tracking via circulating tumor cells, the seed-and-soil model, and metastatic genomic profiles.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides a concluding synthesis of cancer hallmarks and closes the lecture with guidance for practical sessions.
